item.title: Shreyas Iyer to captain Mumbai in remaining Vijay Hazare Trophy league matches: Report
item.description: India’s ODI vice-captain Shreyas Iyer, who has received clearance from the BCCI’s CoE to return to competitive cricket for Mumbai, will lead his domestic team in their final two league matches of the ongoing Vijay Hazare Trophy (VHT) in Jaipur. item.title: WATCH- Rohit Sharma scolds young fans for misbehavior as they try to grab his arm and take a selfie
item.description: Rohit Sharma, former Team India captain, found himself in an embarrassing scenario after arriving in Mumbai from Jamnagar when a small group of admirers gathered around him. Rohit last appeared in the Vijay Hazare Trophy for Mumbai. He made 155 runs against Sikkim before being dismissed with the first ball against Uttarakhand. item.description: Bangladesh pacer Mustafizur Rahman's release from the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 season has caused a rippling effect in the cricketing world, with the International Cricket Council (ICC) apparently being obliged to redraw the T20 World Cup calendar. item.description: Former Indian cricketer Harbhajan Singh responded on Monday to the Bangladesh Cricket Board's (BCB) formal appeal to the International Cricket Council (ICC) to shift the 2026 Men's T20 World Cup matches from India to alternative venues, citing safety and security concerns. item.title: Virat Kohli set to skip Delhi’s Vijay Hazare Trophy fixture against Railways
item.description: Indian batting stalwart Virat Kohli will not feature in Delhi's Vijay Hazare Trophy fixture against Railways on Tuesday (January 6). As per the BCCI mandate, Kohli turned up for Delhi in a couple of matches against Andhra Pradesh and Gujarat. He looked in fine touch, returning with scores of 131 and 77 respectively in those games. item.description: Suryakumar Yadav’s batting numbers have fallen drastically ever since assuming India’s T20I captaincy. item.title: WPL 2026: “Hopefully we can form a women's KL Rahul,” UP Warriorz coach Abhishek Nayar admits trouble with wicketkeeper
item.description: UP Warriorz head coach Abhishek Nayar on Monday (January 5) stated that the franchise is awaiting clearance from the BCCI’s Centre of Excellence (COE) regarding the availability of India batter Pratika Rawal for the upcoming Women’s Premier League (WPL) season.
